name: cloudflare-studio
title: Cloudflare Studio
description: A system of Cloudflare's services as an app: search the catalog to add a service, drag from a Worker's env to what it binds, choose the operations it uses, and give anything that runs code an XState machine, edited in a StateDiagram, with what crosses each connection checked against what the machine receives. Export gives the system's JSON, a wrangler.jsonc for each Worker with what it still needs listed, and a module for each machine, as files: nothing's deployed and there's no account. It's kept in the browser as it changes, and works down to a phone's width, with the inspector in a SideDrawer beside the board or a Credenza under it.
